title: SPCX Reclaims $135 IPO Price for First Time Since Mid-July
detail: SpaceX shares gained about 4% on Monday, August 10, 2026, closing above the stock's $135 IPO price for the first time since it first slipped below that level on July 15. Shares had pointed to roughly $136.20 in premarket trade, up about 2.3% from Friday's close, extending the rebound that began after the August 6 lock-up expiration passed without a feared sell-off. The move came alongside a planned Falcon 9 Starlink launch from Cape Canaveral (Starlink 10-19) that was scrubbed Monday morning and pushed to a Tuesday liftoff.

media.caption: SPCX shares reclaim the $135 IPO price for the first time since July 15
